scheme_name: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
other_conditions: AICTE‑approved institute must have existed for at least 5 years
Only one proposal per institute is allowed, with a minimum of 50 student members in the club
Institute must contribute a minimum of ₹1,00,000 to the club (higher contributions receive extra weightage)
Coordinator must be a full‑time regular faculty with at least 10 years of teaching/industry experience
Co‑coordinator must be a faculty member with at least 5 years of teaching/industry experience
Coordinator and co‑coordinator should have experience/inclination for organizing co‑curricular events
All students enrolled in the institute are eligible to be club members; ex‑students, ex‑faculty and other officials cannot be members
Clubs are encouraged to seek fundraising from alumni and industry
Coordinator’s academic background must align with the club’s theme
Each institute can receive the grant only once
benefits_summary: One‑time grant of ₹1,00,000 per institute for a year to support student clubs that foster interests, creativity, and ethics.
